scope: All 8 Rajshahi Division districts; partial research batch, not all doctors.
methodology: Original master preserved; new records appended after exact normalized name+clinic+district comparison.
Name-based IDs are approximate, not BMDC identity verification.
Bangla and English name variants may remain and require manual BMDC identity matching.
New records have source URLs and source-observation date; no phone verification performed.
Missing consultation fees remain null; masked contact numbers not copied.
Original historical JSON remains untouched, including previously reported NaN values. Only final/ is strict JSON.
limitations: RajDoctors listing crawl covered pages 1–15 for Bogura, Pabna and Rajshahi; additional pages remain.
Other districts use selected publicly accessible hospital/doctor rosters; district-wide exhaustive coverage not claimed.
Secondary source text may contain errors or stale schedules; confirm directly before booking.
Some original records share chamber IDs; these pre-existing records were not deleted.
No portraits downloaded; any image_source_url is a reference only.
